## **What are Strings?**

-   Sequences of characters used to represent text data
-   Text data stored as character vectors
-   To standardize (i.e format variables as per CDISC Standards)
-   Remove unwanted characters or special characters

## Load

```{r}
library(tidyverse)  # uses "stringr" package
```

### Create

```{r}
# Simple string
drug_name <- "Aspirin"
drug_name

# Character vector
ae_terms <- c("Headache", "Nausea", "Fatigue")

class(ae_terms)
```

### Operations

| **Function**   | **Description**                |
|:---------------|:-------------------------------|
| `str_c()`      | Concatenate strings            |
| `str_length()` | Get character count            |
| `str_sub()`    | Extract substrings by position |

### Concatenation

```{r}
str_c("Adverse Event ", "(Headache)")          
str_c(ae_terms, collapse = ", ")            
```

### Length

```{r}
str_length("Hypertension")                    
```

### Substring

```{r}
str_sub("STUDY001", start = 6, end = 8) 
```

### Case Conversion

| **Function**     | Description           |
|:-----------------|:----------------------|
| `str_to_upper()` | Convert to uppercase  |
| `str_to_lower()` | Convert to lowercase  |
| `str_to_title()` | Title case formatting |

```{r}
str_to_upper("aspirin")                        
str_to_lower("METFORMIN")                      
str_to_title("drug safety")                    
```

### **Pattern Matching & Extraction**

| **Function**    | **Description**          |
|:----------------|:-------------------------|
| `str_detect()`  | Detect pattern presence  |
| `str_which()`   | Find element positions   |
| `str_extract()` | Extract matched patterns |
| `str_remove()`  | Remove pattern           |

## Regex

A **regular expression (regex)** is a sequence of characters that defines a search pattern for text processing. Regex allows you to:

-   Match specific patterns in strings

-   Extract substrings

-   Replace text

-   Validate formats (e.g., patient IDs, dates)

### Category

| **Category**      | **Regex Pattern** | **Matches**                         |
|:------------------|:------------------|:---------------------------------|
| **Digits**        | `[[:digit:]]`     | Any digit (0–9)                     |
| **Letters**       | `[[:alpha:]]`     | Alphabetic characters               |
| **Alphanumeric**  | `[[:alnum:]]`     | Letters + numbers                   |
| **Punctuation**   | `[[:punct:]]`     | `! " # $ % & ' ( ) * + , - . / : ;` |
| **Whitespace**    | `[[:space:]]`     | Spaces, tabs, newlines              |
| **Lowercase**     | `[[:lower:]]`     | Lowercase letters                   |
| **Uppercase**     | `[[:upper:]]`     | Uppercase letters                   |
| **Fixed Strings** | `fixed("text")`   | Exact literal match                 |

### Patterns

```{r}
string <- "Severe headache"
str_detect(string, "Severe")   

str_which(ae_terms, "Nausea")               
```

### Extract

```{r}
string <- "TRTA 10"

str_extract_all(string, "[[:digit:]]+")  
```

### Remove

```{r}
string <- "Aspirin!"

str_remove_all(string, "[[:punct:]]") 
```

## String Splitting & Replace

| **Function**    | **Description**            |
|:----------------|:---------------------------|
| `str_split()`   | Split strings by delimiter |
| `str_replace()` | Replace first match        |

### Split

```{r}
string <- "A01,A02,A03"

str_split(string, pattern = ",")       
```

### Replacement

```{r}
string <- "BP=120/80"

str_replace(string, "120", "130")
```

### Whitespace & Padding

| **Function**   | **Description**                                  |
|:---------------|:-------------------------------------------------|
| `str_pad()`    | Pad strings to fixed width                       |
| `str_trim()`   | Remove leading/trailing whitespace               |
| `str_squish()` | Remove leading/trailing and all other whitespace |
|                |                                                  |

### Padding

```{r}
str_pad("5", width = 3, side = "left", pad = "0")  # "005"
```

### Remove Space

```{r}
string <- " Hello \t World \n"
string

str_trim(string)

str_squish(string)
```

# Dates

## What are Dates?

-   Dates are stored as Date objects in R (number of days since 1970-01-01)
-   Time is stored as POSIXct (seconds since 1970-01-01)

## Date formats

| **Date Example** | **Description**                 |
|:-----------------|:--------------------------------|
| `"2023-05-15"`   | YYYY-MM-DD (ISO 8601)           |
| `"15MAY2023"`    | DDMMMYYYY (SAS format)          |
| `"05/15/2023"`   | MM/DD/YYYY (US format)          |
| `"15-05-2023"`   | DD-MM-YYYY (EU and Asia format) |

## Create Dates

```{r}
# From character strings
as.Date("2023-05-15")    # ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD)
mdy("05/15/2023")         # Month-Day-Year
dmy("15-May-2023")        # Day-Month-Year

# From numeric values
as.Date(19500, origin = "1970-01-01") 
```

## Date parsing functions

| **Function**        | **Input Format**          | **Example Input**    |
|:--------------------|:--------------------------|:---------------------|
| `ymd()`             | Year-Month-Day            | `"2023-05-15"`       |
| `mdy()`             | Month-Day-Year            | `"05/15/2023"`       |
| `dmy()`             | Day-Month-Year            | `"15-05-2023"`       |
| `ydm()`             | Year-Day-Month            | `"2023-15-05"`       |
| `ymd_hms()`         | Year-Month-Day H:M:S      | `"2023-05-15 14:30"` |
| `mdy_hm()`          | Month-Day-Year H:M        | `"05/15/2023 14:30"` |
| `dmy_h()`           | Day-Month-Year Hour       | `"15-05-2023 14"`    |
| `parse_date_time()` | Flexible multiple formats | `"15May2023"`        |

# Date Operation

### Extract Date Components

```{r}
today <- today()
today

year(today)    # Extract year
month(today)    # Extract month
day(today)      # Extract day
weekdays(today) # Extract weekdays
```

### Adding/Subtracting Days:

```{r}
date <- as.Date("2025-03-31")
date

date + 10  # Add 10 days
date - 5   # Subtract 5 days
```

### Calculating Date Differences:

```{r}
start_date <- as.Date("2025-01-01")
end_date <- as.Date("2025-03-31")

as.numeric(end_date - start_date)
```

# Partial Date and Imputation

## Partial Date Format

| **Component**      | **Unknown Marker** | **Example**  |
|:-------------------|:-------------------|:-------------|
| Day                | `UN`               | `2023-UN-15` |
| Month              | `UN`               | `2023-06-UN` |
| Year               | `UN`               | `UN-06-15`   |
| Completely unknown | `UNK`              | `UNK`        |

### Example 1

-   Unknown month ("2023-UN-15" → "2023")

```{r}
un_month <- "2023-UN-15"
partial_month <- str_replace(un_month, "-UN-\\d{2}$", "")  # Remove "-UN-15"

partial_month
```

### Example 2

-   Unknown day ("2023-06-UN" → "2023-06")

```{r}
un_day <- "2023-06-UN"
partial_day <- str_replace(un_day, "-UN$", "")  # Remove "-UN"

partial_day
```

## Date Imputation

| **Example Input** | **Imputation Rule**                  | **Imputed Output** |
|:-----------------|:---------------------------------|:------------------|
| `"1990"`          | Add `-01-01` (Jan 1st)               | `"1990-01-01"`     |
| `"2005-08"`       | Add `-01` (1st day of month)         | `"2005-08-01"`     |
| `"1988-12-25"`    | **No imputation** (already complete) | `"1988-12-25"`     |

```{r}

str_c(partial_day, "-01") |> as.Date()

str_c(partial_month, "-01-01") |> as.Date()

```

## Format code for Date

| **Code** | **Meaning**         | **Example Output** |
|:---------|:--------------------|:-------------------|
| `%Y`     | 4-digit year        | `"2023"`           |
| `%y`     | 2-digit year        | `"23"`             |
| `%m`     | 2-digit month       | `"05"`             |
| `%B`     | Full month name     | `"March"`          |
| `%b`     | Abbreviated month   | `"Mar"`            |
| `%d`     | 2-digit day         | `"15"`             |
| `%A`     | Full weekday name   | `"Monday"`         |
| `%a`     | Abbreviated weekday | `"Mon"`            |
| `%H`     | 24-hour hour        | `"14"`             |
| `%I`     | 12-hour hour        | `"02"`             |
| `%M`     | Minutes             | `"30"`             |
| `%S`     | Seconds             | `"05"`             |
| `%F`     | ISO 8601 date       | `"2023-05-15"`     |
| `%T`     | ISO 8601 time       | `"14:30:00"`       |

## Example

```{r}
as.Date("1990-05-12")  # YYYY-MM-DD (default format)
as.Date("15-09-1992", format="%d-%m-%Y")  # DD-MM-YYYY
as.Date("03/31/2025", format="%m/%d/%Y")  # MM/DD/YYYY
as.Date("20250330", format="%Y%m%d")  # YYYYMMDD
as.Date("12JAN2025", format="%d%b%Y") # DDMMMYYYY
```
